title: The plugin's horizon --hook and intake hook entries run only when the host project's backlog.json key turns them on
goal: plugin.json carries the SessionStart entries for backlog.py horizon --hook and intake --file --hook, and each does nothing (prints nothing, exits 0, files nothing) unless the host project's backlog.json names it in a settings key that defaults to off; the kb's own .claude/settings.json hooks keep running as they do (its backlog.json turns the key on, or its entries are not the plugin's); the key is a SETTINGS entry, so an unknown value is refused naming the key; plugin.json's hook list and kb/_self/plugin.md name the key

gates.question: How does the plugin's hook entry know the host project opted in, without changing the kb's own hooks in .claude/settings.json?
options: flag: the plugin's two entries run horizon --hook and intake --file --hook with an --opt-in flag, which makes the command do nothing unless backlog.json's hooks setting (default []) names horizon or intake; the kb's .claude/settings.json entries run without the flag and are unchanged
key only: every --hook run reads the hooks setting (default []), and the kb's backlog.json names both, so the kb's behaviour rests on one more key of its file
gates.recommendation: flag: the plugin's two entries run horizon --hook and intake --file --hook with an --opt-in flag, which makes the command do nothing unless backlog.json's hooks setting (default []) names horizon or intake; the kb's .claude/settings.json entries run without the flag and are unchanged
gates.answer: flag: the plugin's two entries run horizon --hook and intake --file --hook with an --opt-in flag, which makes the command do nothing unless backlog.json's hooks setting (default []) names horizon or intake; the kb's .claude/settings.json entries run without the flag and are unchanged

gates.question: What does --opt-in do when it is given without --hook?
options: refuse: exit 1 naming that --opt-in goes with --hook
ignore: the flag is read only with --hook and the command runs as without it
gates.recommendation: refuse: exit 1 naming that --opt-in goes with --hook
